wording: P85 estimates the probability that adaptive walks (each step to a random fitter neighbour, ending at a peak) reach the highest 1, 5, 14 or 25% of peaks: it varies widely among six empirical landscapes, is generally comparable to or smaller than in Rough Mount Fuji landscapes of similar ruggedness, and falls with ruggedness (RMF P14% from 96.3% at sigma 0.5 to 26.4% at sigma 10; NK from 100% at K 0 to 24.8% at K 8; House of Cards about 25%); peak height and basin size correlate positively in every landscape (R_ph-bs 0.69-0.97) but this does not guarantee a large probability of reaching a high peak.
locator: P85 Introduction, Results (Table 1, Figs. 1-4), Methods (read in full; supplementary figures not read)
confidence: Moderate (one computational study of six empirical and several model landscapes)
counterevidence_limits: Empirical landscapes are a few protein/RNA systems; P85 notes P14% cannot be fairly compared with very few peaks (NK K 0-1). P85 also reports that a 1/28 chance calculation in the study it re-examines (Papkou et al.) was incorrect.
operationalization: NAT Ascendence = adaptive walks climbing a fitness landscape
verification_phrases: P85|lowering landscape ruggedness boosts P HP || P85|which is always around 25% || P85|ranges from 0.69 to 0.97 in the six empirical landscapes

wording: On 6-site four-state landscapes (one walk from every genotype, 10 landscapes per type) the chance of reaching the top 14% of peaks fell with RMF ruggedness (0.84 at sigma 0.5, 0.32 at sigma 2, 0.21 at sigma 10), was 0.21 for House of Cards (P85: about 25%), exceeded 0.14 for every landscape type, and peak height correlated positively with basin size in every landscape (minimum r 0.43; mean 0.93 at sigma 0.5 falling to 0.49-0.50 for sigma 10 and HoC). NK K 4 gave 0.243 vs 0.252 at K 1, so the pre-registered 'lower at K 4' held only narrowly; in the seed-99 smoke test it went the other way (0.240 vs 0.202), and with about 10 peaks at K 1 'top 14%' is the global peak alone, so this comparison is not robust.
confidence: Moderate (10 landscapes per type, 4096 genotypes each)
counterevidence_limits: Much smaller landscapes than P85's 9 sites; model landscapes only; the NK K comparison is fragile and seed-dependent (disclosed).
operationalization: NAT Ascendence = adaptive walks to high peaks
